title: Table Column and Row Emphasis Examples
author: SnapLogic

sections.title: First Column Bold (Row Labels)
sections.content:
Use **first-bold** to emphasize the first column as row labels. Perfect for making table structure clear.

[TABLE:simple:Regional Performance Summary:first-bold]
| Region | Customers | Revenue | Growth |
|--------|-----------|---------|--------|
| North America | 450 | $3.2M | 22% |
| EMEA | 380 | $2.8M | 18% |
| APAC | 290 | $1.9M | 31% |
| LATAM | 120 | $750K | 15% |
[/TABLE]

Table 1 shows how first column bold improves readability for row-based data.

sections.title: Last Column Emphasis (Key Metrics)
sections.content:
Use **last-[color]** to highlight the final column with accent colors. Great for drawing attention to key metrics, totals, or priorities.

**Last Column with Jade (Success/Positive):**

[TABLE:simple:Feature Readiness Status:last-jade]
| Feature | Target Date | Dependencies | Status |
|---------|-------------|--------------|--------|
| API v2.0 | Q2 2026 | None | Complete |
| Mobile App | Q3 2026 | API v2.0 | On Track |
| Analytics | Q4 2026 | Data Pipeline | Planning |
[/TABLE]

**Last Column with Orange (Attention/Priority):**

[TABLE:simple:Risk Assessment Matrix:last-orange]
| Risk Category | Probability | Impact | Priority |
|---------------|-------------|--------|----------|
| Security Breach | Low | High | CRITICAL |
| Performance Degradation | Medium | Medium | HIGH |
| UI Bug | High | Low | MEDIUM |
[/TABLE]

**Last Column with Blue (Information):**

[TABLE:simple:System Requirements:last-blue]
| Component | Minimum | Recommended | Optimal |
|-----------|---------|-------------|---------|
| CPU | 2 cores | 4 cores | 8+ cores |
| RAM | 8GB | 16GB | 32GB+ |
| Storage | 100GB | 250GB | 500GB+ |
[/TABLE]

Tables 2-4 demonstrate how accent colors emphasize important columns.

sections.title: Total Rows (Summary Emphasis)
sections.content:
Use **total-row** to emphasize the last row as a summary/total. The row gets bold text and accent background.

**Total Row with Navy Background:**

[TABLE:simple:Quarterly Revenue 2026:total-row]
| Quarter | Sales | Costs | Profit |
|---------|-------|-------|--------|
| Q1 | $1.2M | $800K | $400K |
| Q2 | $1.5M | $900K | $600K |
| Q3 | $1.8M | $950K | $850K |
| Q4 | $2.1M | $1.1M | $1.0M |
| Total | $6.6M | $3.75M | $2.85M |
[/TABLE]

Table 5 uses a total row to emphasize the summary.

sections.title: Combined Emphasis Options
sections.content:
Combine multiple options for maximum clarity. Use **first-bold,last-jade,total-row** for comprehensive emphasis.

**Example: Sales Performance Dashboard**

[TABLE:simple:Sales Team Performance Q1 2026:first-bold,last-jade,total-row]
| Sales Rep | Deals Closed | Revenue | Quota Attainment |
|-----------|--------------|---------|------------------|
| Sarah Chen | 12 | $450K | 112% |
| Mike Rodriguez | 8 | $320K | 95% |
| Emily Johnson | 15 | $580K | 145% |
| David Park | 10 | $380K | 98% |
| Team Total | 45 | $1.73M | 112% |
[/TABLE]

**Example: Budget Allocation Analysis**

[TABLE:simple:Department Budget Allocation 2026:first-bold,last-orange]
| Department | Headcount | Operating Costs | Budget Status |
|------------|-----------|-----------------|---------------|
| Engineering | 45 | $5.2M | Over Budget |
| Sales | 30 | $3.8M | On Track |
| Marketing | 15 | $2.1M | Under Budget |
| Operations | 20 | $2.4M | On Track |
[/TABLE]

Tables 6-7 combine first column bold with highlighted last columns and total rows.

sections.title: All Emphasis Options Combined
sections.content:
The ultimate example using all three emphasis types together:

[TABLE:simple:2026 Product Line Performance Analysis:first-bold,last-blue,total-row]
| Product Line | Units Sold | Market Share | Customer Satisfaction |
|--------------|------------|--------------|----------------------|
| Enterprise Suite | 1,200 | 35% | 4.8/5.0 |
| Professional Tools | 3,400 | 28% | 4.6/5.0 |
| Starter Package | 8,900 | 22% | 4.5/5.0 |
| Add-ons & Extensions | 15,600 | 15% | 4.7/5.0 |
| Combined Portfolio | 29,100 | 100% | 4.65/5.0 |
[/TABLE]

Table 8 demonstrates maximum emphasis: first column bold (product names), last column highlighted blue (key metric), and total row emphasized (portfolio summary).

sections.title: Style Selection Guide
sections.content:
**When to use each emphasis option:**

[TABLE:minimal:Table Emphasis Decision Matrix]
| Emphasis Type | When to Use | Color Options | Best For |
|---------------|-------------|---------------|----------|
| first-bold | Row labels, categories | N/A (just bold) | Any table with named rows |
| last-jade | Success metrics, positive results | Jade background | Status columns, completion rates |
| last-orange | Warnings, priorities, costs | Orange background | Risk levels, urgent items |
| last-blue | Key information, targets | Blue background | Goals, recommendations |
| total-row | Summary/aggregate data | Navy background | Financial tables, dashboards |
[/TABLE]

Table 9 helps choose the right emphasis options.
